entry_contract.frame_domain: global integer f in [0,3600); local f in [0,clip.dur)
entry_contract.scene_frame: find scene by in <= global_f < out; scene_f = global_f - scene.in
entry_contract.input_sanitization: Finite numeric input floored, then clamped to [0,dur-1]; NaN/nonfinite =>0. Validate entry start/dur as exact recipe values. Never clamp global_f at299.
entry_contract.determinism: Pure state from global_f + immutable inputs. No elapsed time, requestAnimationFrame clock, Math.random, or accumulated previous-frame state. Repeated/reverse/shuffled f must produce identical state.
entry_contract.camera: One cameraFromGlobalFrame result applies to all geometry in the shared world. Intentional foreground wing override [264,345) uses the same B transform on both bird pages. Source slips and subtitles use screen-space safe areas.
entry_contract.mask_contract: Each HTML page recreates its own SVG definitions from shared resolved world geometry. No cross-document url(#id), no duplicate opaque gate painted on bird pages. Body and wings consume bit-identical B visibility regions; retain page-specific ID prefixes to avoid collisions.
entry_contract.renderer_path: Keep current navigation-based page protocol; expose existing __vtx_render(local_f) for deterministic testing only. Do not declare navfree eligibility, static spans, beginFrame or canvas-export fast paths.

clip_dependency_rule: List all actually loaded local files including scene modules/font/license-linked font inputs and waveform JSON at build time; not transitive by assumption. Add waveform only to T13 unless genuinely shared. Effects file always declared. No remote assets.

paper.audio: Do not create audio event for the compatibility silence stream.

missing_assets_rule: Do not create empty HTML, placeholder WAV or random envelope to report completed20. Builder must reject absent final source assets. The blueprint below is schema-shaped design only.
z_rule: Use this fixed array order. Any locally lower object that passes in front is handled by the upper page excluding shared occluder geometry. Tools/strip/F pages must also obey contact masks. Maskless copies are diagnostics only.
audio_rule: Four full120-second stems with sample-accurate internal rests. Timeline events use one source each, no looping. Unity interchange volume is a placeholder export convention, not an approved mix decision.
